idea-plugin.name: ZplFlow - ZPL Live Preview & Label Tools
idea-plugin.description:
The complete developer tooling suite for Zebra Programming Language (ZPL) in JetBrains IDEs, powered by ZplFlow.

✨ Features

  • Embedded Language Server (LSP 3.17 - Offline): Local autocompletion, hover documentation, syntax validation, and parameter breakdown for 188+ Zebra commands with bundled cross-platform binaries (Linux, macOS, Windows).
  • Pixel-Perfect Live Preview (Cloud API): Interactive JCEF live preview of thermal labels side-by-side with your code (requires a free ZplFlow API key, 0 token charge on preview).
  • Interactive Label Dimensions & Presets: Quick presets (4x6", 4x4", 4x3", 3x2", 2x1", Custom) and real-time W/H millimeter adjustments directly from the preview toolbar.
  • Multi-DPI Resolution Switching: Switch dynamically between 152, 203, 300, and 600 DPI printhead profiles.
  • Native Syntax Highlighting: Fast local lexer distinguishing commands, numeric parameters, field data, commas, and label boundaries.
  • SHA-256 LRU Cache: Instant undo/redo with zero redundant server round-trips.
  • Code Formatting & Auto-indent: Reformat ZPL commands into clean, indented blocks with Ctrl + Alt + L.

🚀 Quick Start

  1. Open any .zpl, .prn, or .label file.
  2. Configure your free API key under Settings > Tools > ZplFlow (link provided in settings).
  3. Open the ZplFlow Preview Tool Window on the right sidebar.
  4. Edit your ZPL code to see real-time preview updates, syntax highlighting, and LSP parameter suggestions.
